execution.implementation: Dated retrieval and deterministic reduction of official RCSB 4V1W entry and biological assembly 1 symmetry metadata

observations: RCSB biological assembly 1 is a homomeric A24 assembly with 32,736 polymer atoms and 4,080 modeled polymer residues.
The returned global symmetry record is octahedral O with six order-2, four order-3, and three order-4 rotation axes.
The retained cluster has 24 members and an average RMSD of 0.024336751 angstrom.
interpretation: The RCSB octahedral annotation describes the organization of the 24-subunit ferritin shell in biological assembly 1.
limitations: The public assembly annotation does not independently establish oligomerization under every solution condition.
The preview is a metadata schematic and does not claim displayed viewer axes, cage, cluster coloring, or camera state.
Archive-derived metadata may change after the retrieval date.
rosalind_open did not submit 4V1W, retrieve assembly metadata, analyze symmetry, or execute a Rosalind scientific job.

provenance.note: The retained record includes source URLs, coordinate hash, entry facts, assembly counts, every axis endpoint, and all member/operator identities; the separate genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation states that no Rosalind scientific job ran.

reproduction: Run python scripts/fetch_assembly_metadata.py with network access to the official RCSB Data API.
Compare the regenerated dated JSON with the retained preview and source hash.
